Are US Long Bonds A Buy? (Part IV)

Will Denyer

Gavekal Research | 28 Sep 2026

Does it make sense to hold US bonds as part of a balanced portfolio? This question should immediately bring back uncomfortable memories of 2022, when aggressive monetary policy tightening by the Federal Reserve triggered a sell-off in both equities and bonds. The S&P 500 index fell some -20% that year, while 10-15-year treasuries fell by a similar amount. As a result, “balanced portfolios” of equities and bonds did horribly.With that unpleasant memory still fresh, and the Fed now starting another tightening cycle, it may seem ludicrous to even entertain the idea of hedging equity exposure with bonds. This is especially true given that monetary tightening is hardly the only cause for concern among bond investors today (see The Challenge For Fixed Income Investors).
